import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_80/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be added here
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select required columns, and append to list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only 'movieId' and 'rating' columns as per target schema
        df_selected = df[['movieId', 'rating']]
        dfs.append(df_selected)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If needed, aggregate ratings by movieId (e.g., average rating)
    # The target examples show averaged ratings, so we do the same:
    target_df = combined_df.groupby('movieId', as_index=False)['rating'].mean()

    # Write the transformed data to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_80/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
